verdict.rationale: Porting out is a fair question for a business phone platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers porting a number in ("One new or ported phone number") and a cancel-anytime trial. Neither is a documented port-out process, fee policy, or in-app account/PIN details for the gaining carrier.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my number out without lock-in fees, with the account details the gaining carrier needs available in the app
